proposition: When the Yazd delegation failed, his enemies compiled a case from statements in works of his youth, claiming to find for example a verse praising ʿAlī and condemning ʿUmar and ʿUthmān.

mediation.who: Maʿṣūm ʿAlī Shāh, Ṭarāʾiq al-Ḥaqāʾiq, 3/30, and the introduction to the Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr
mediation.note: a 19th-century Niʿmatullahi source; the first apology does not mention the pretext
